presentation.summary: Two-way watched movie and episode sync between Silo and Watcharr.
presentation.description_markdown:
Synchronizes watched movies and watched TV episodes between Silo and a self-hosted Watcharr instance using Silo's watch_sync_provider.v1 pipeline. The plugin acts as a stateless protocol adapter; Silo owns scheduling, credentials, retries, ordering, and reconciliation.

Community plugin by Mildman1848 (https://github.com/mildman1848/silo-plugin-sync-watcharr), built for Bloem on the Bloem plugin SDK.
presentation.setup_markdown:
1. Install the plugin.
2. Configure the Watcharr Base URL, for example `https://watcharr.example.test`.
3. In your Silo profile, connect the Watcharr provider with your Watcharr username and password. The Silo UI patch for this image shows separate fields and sends them safely to the existing WatchSync API-key endpoint as structured JSON. The plugin exchanges them for Watcharr's JWT and Silo stores only the returned token encrypted.
4. Enable watched import/export for movies and episodes.

Deletion/unwatched events are not exported in v1 unless Watcharr exposes a safe reversible semantics for your workflow.

capabilities.description: Imports and exports watched movies and TV episodes to Watcharr.
